title: AI Customer Support Agent
summary: I completed and evaluated an offline support agent that predicts intent, retrieves historical evidence, drafts grounded guidance, and routes risky requests to a human.
completed: Evaluated B0, B1, and B2 on 150 held-out cases
Completed 60 blinded human and 60 judge ratings
next: B2 reached 95.95% escalation recall, but all six automatically handled cases were unsafe under the route labels. Automatic handling remains disabled.
